steps.title: Define UI layout color theme and application string resources
steps.description: Configure colors.xml, strings.xml, and styles.xml for dark video player and paywall theme.

steps.description: Design button drawables, background containers, and vector control icons.

steps.title: Implement TrialPaywallManager for Cloudflare worker validation and cache logic

steps.title: Design watch history UI layout and list item layout

steps.title: Implement HistoryActivity for viewing and clearing watch history

steps.description: Integrate paywall verification flow, WhatsApp proof action, status re-check, and background video player bridge.

steps.description: Compile and assemble the final binary for BG Tube Player.
